description: This file defines utility classes, functions, and command infrastructure for an IDL command-line interface in the Android project, including argument parsing, command registration, and command execution logic.

classes.name: Args
classes.description: Handles command-line argument parsing and retrieval.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Abstract base class for CLI commands, managing execution flow and usage printing.

classes.name: CommandRegistry
classes.description: Singleton registry for command creation and listing.

methods.description: Prints command description and usage details.
